approval_message: Root independently reviewed exact ProjectionAtlasBoundary.lean SHA481f8b0d1ee4b287c211f40732426ae02aade21c6c45cdcf8b0f530c7763607c and rationale. Approve boundary C for implementation. Genuine chart targets open in S exclude extra sheets; coordinate-minor IFT gives injectivity on an ambient ball intersected with S. Compact orthonormal frames should yield a uniform finite inverse bound; convex coordinate balls yield Lipschitz branches. Countable chart refinement handles Borel pieces and disjointness. Please explicitly handle m=0 (discrete second-countable S is countable; base is singleton) and empty S; no optimal K needed. No volume/semialgebraic hypothesis or conclusion is hidden. Preserve definitions/proposition for audit, then prove it or exact equivalent helper structure with re-review if boundary changes. D remains separate and unproved.
